name: Expense Parser
description: Extracts merchant, amount, payment method, and date from a pasted UPI / card / bank message.
instruction: Extract the transaction merchant, amount in INR, payment method (upi/card/cash/bank), and the transaction date in ISO-8601. Use null for fields that are not present.

rules.title: Large expense logged
rules.body: An expense over ₹5,000 was just saved.
